newsitem.title: USA: US sour crudes sell weaker on talk of Iraqi supply.
newsitem.headline: US sour crudes sell weaker on talk of Iraqi supply.

text.p: U.S. sour crudes were sold Thursday at differentials some 30 cents weaker than on Wednesday, reflecting bearish fundamentals amidst talk of increasing Iraqi crude offerings in the U.S. Gulf.
Traders said deals were heard at April West Texas Intermediate/Cushing -$2.50, 10 cts lower than morning trades and some 30 cts down from late yesterday.

Markets were not certain on the status of Iraqi cargoes on offer for April delivery, but talk had some of Bayoil and Coastal Corp's Iraqi crude bought Wednesday at weak differentials. There was no confirmation of the deals.
